Standard: Avionics controls reliably maintain control of all SCFs. Safety-critical avionics control modes will use a probability of failure of 10-7 unless a different value is specified and justified based upon the controlled function. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct analysis to verify control functionality in design documentation and FMEA. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct laboratory testing to verify reliability achieves a probability of failure of 10-7 or a different value if it is specified and justified based upon the function.
  (2) Ground test: Ground testing validates analyses and lab test results and verifies reliability of safety-critical avionics controls. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (3) Flight test: Flight testing validates analyses and lab test results and verifies reliability of safety-critical avionics controls.
